transcript.text: Mara, here is my fire safety report. I confirmed with the insurer's underwriter that our coverage on Soundstage 3 excludes any open-flame brazier on this stage. However, the insurer does permit an LED-flame prop, provided two conditions are met: first, the LED-flame prop must remain at least 12 meters from the sprinkler-head cluster on the stage, and second, its certification must be filed before filming begins. The endorsement reflecting these terms is currently awaiting countersignature. I want the group to be aware that any design or set dressing involving flame elements must use the LED-flame prop, not an open-flame brazier, and the 12-meter distance from the sprinkler-head cluster and the certification filing are both hard conditions for coverage. Dev, this is relevant to your crash mat placement — if any flame element is positioned near the stunt lane area, we'll need to ensure the 12-meter clearance from the sprinkler-head cluster is maintained, and the crash mat materials should be compatible with proximity to an LED-flame prop.
